name: Shielded Fighter
summary: A shield specialist who blends offense and defense, shares protection, controls flanking lanes, and masters shield resilience.

features.name: Active Defense +1
features.summary: While wielding a shield and fighting defensively, using Combat Expertise, or taking total defense, gain +1 dodge AC and share it with adjacent allies.

features.name: Shield Fighter +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on shield-bash attack and damage rolls and alternate weapon and shield attacks without gaining extra attacks or two-weapon penalties.

features.name: Shield Buffet
features.summary: As a move action, make a maneuver check to give an adjacent enemy -2 on attacks against you and -2 AC against your attacks.

features.name: Swift Shield Buffet
features.summary: Use Shield Buffet as a swift action.

features.name: Shield Guard
features.summary: Designate adjacent squares based on shield size; enemies there cannot flank you or contribute to flanking.

features.name: Shield Mastery
features.summary: Gain DR 5/— while wielding a shield.

features.name: Shield Ward
features.summary: Gain evasion with a shield, add its base shield bonus to Reflex saves and touch AC, and make it immune to disarm and sunder.
